# EndsWith

Tells whether text ends with a given suffix.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
EndsWith(text, suffix)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to test. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `suffix` | string | The suffix to look for, matched exactly, case included. Every text ends with the empty string. |

## Returns

Boolean. True when text ends with suffix, false otherwise. Never null.

## Example

`EndsWith("filename.txt", ".txt")` returns true.
